title: On the maximum $σ$-irregularity of trees with given order and maximum degree
summary: The $σ$-irregularity index of a graph is defined as the sum of squared degree differences over all edges and provides a sensitive measure of structural heterogeneity. In this paper, we study the problem of maximizing $σ(T)$ among all trees of fixed order $n$ and prescribed maximum degree $Δ\ge4$. By expressing the problem in terms of edge--degree multiplicities, we derive a linear programming formulation and analyze its dual.
